16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1992|05f55f8a.name: Tarindrella
1992|05f55f8a.text: Only in Nature do we find purity.

2079|26ba7149.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
2079|26ba7149.text: Ah, the beauty of Shadowglen never ceases to delight my senses!

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3389|5612724d.name: Regthar Deathgate
3389|5612724d.text: We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3489|68d65f37.name: Zargh
3489|68d65f37.text: Have a look at my meats, friend.  You won't want to go out into the Barrens without a good stock of provisions.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

5943|a28d29e1.name: Rawrk
5943|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6928|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Grosk
6928|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

3281-complete.name: Gazrog
3281-complete.text:
Aha!  So the raptors did hide the silver at their lair.  It's hard to believe these beasts would have the desire for silver.  Perhaps the stories of their intelligence are not as far from the mark as I thought!

Thank you, $N.  Take this as a reward for your service to us, and know that the guards of the crossroads owe their next month's pay to you.
3281-complete.title: Stolen Silver

456-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
456-accept.text:
Greetings, $N.  I am Conservator Ilthalaine.  My purpose in Shadowglen is to ensure that the balance of nature is maintained.

The spring rains were particularly heavy this year, causing some of the forest's beasts to flourish while others suffered.

Unfortunately, the nightsaber and thistle boar populations grew too large.  Shadowglen can only produce so much food for the beasts.  Journey forth, young $c, and thin the boar and saber populations so that nature's harmony will be preserved.
456-accept.title: The Balance of Nature

457-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
457-accept.text:
Thinning the younger population of creatures here in Shadowglen was a good start, $N, but there is still work to be done.

The resources of the forest will be depleted too quickly if the problem is not addressed.  Killing nature's beasts is a necessary evil for the good of all who share the land.  Venture into the forest and slay mangy nightsabers and thistle boars in the name of balance.
457-accept.title: The Balance of Nature

458-accept.name: Melithar Staghelm
458-accept.text:
Thank goodness you are here, $c. Strange news has traveled to me through the whisperings of the forest spirits.

The mysterious woodland protector, Tarindrella, has returned to Shadowglen. The dryad's presence has not been felt in the forests of Kalimdor in years. Something is surely amiss if she has journeyed back to this land.

Seek out Tarindrella and see what business she tends to in our grove. One of the Sentinels reported seeing her to the southwest of Aldrassil.
458-accept.title: The Woodland Protector

458-complete.name: Tarindrella
458-complete.text: I see you found me, young $r.  Melithar is a wise druid to have sent you. But you still have much to learn. I understand your kind enjoys books. Please take one of these to further your education.
458-complete.title: The Woodland Protector

459-accept.name: Tarindrella
459-accept.text:
Something evil is brewing in the forests of Teldrassil.  Look long the hills to where the peaceful furbolgs used to dwell.  They have deserted their homes and are amassing under the name of the Gnarlpine tribe.

Only the corruption of wicked Fel Moss could cause such a transformation.  The grells and grellkin have infested the area and are threatening the residents of Shadowglen.  

Engage these grells and grellkin, $N, and see if they are indeed caught under the enchantment of the wicked Fel Moss.
459-accept.title: The Woodland Protector

865-complete.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
865-complete.text: Great, you got them!  Now I just need to ground them down and mix them with some wine, and...
865-complete.title: Raptor Horns

865-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
865-progress.text: Did you get the horns, $N?  Those things are going to make me a fortune!
865-progress.title: Raptor Horns

867-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-accept.text:
The blasted harpies have been ravaging our caravan supplies for too long. It's time we slit a few of their throats and diminished their numbers.

I've been snooping around their nests and figured out who leads who. The most devastating attack will destroy a good section of their lower chain of command and then we can work our way to the top.

I'll start you off slow, take out Witchwing Harpies and Witchwing Roguefeathers in the Northwest and bring me 8 Witchwing talons. That should be a good start...
867-accept.title: Harpy Raiders

868-accept.name: Korran
868-accept.text:
Hey, $N. I been sent to the Crossroads to watch over the land and take note of its happenings for my masters in Orgrimmar.

One object of my studies are the insect-like creatures found to the south in the Field of Giants. We know little of the creatures, so I be makin' it a point to discover more. They seem to have intelligence to them, more so than any normal animal.

Take this digging claw and collect some of the creatures' eggs from their mounds, but be careful: if alerted, they will attack you.
868-accept.title: Egg Hunt

887-complete.name: Gazlowe
887-complete.text:
You did good, kid. A little more work like that, and it'll be one less thing I'll have to worry about. Hopefully they'll be convinced that they should relocate their operation elsewhere.

In the meantime, there is the small matter of getting back the goods they stole from me!
887-complete.title: Southsea Freebooters

890-accept.name: Gazlowe
890-accept.text:
I've been waiting forever for my last shipment of goods from Booty Bay! I'm pretty sure that it must have been stolen by the Freebooters, but just to make sure, will you go down to the dockside and ask Dizzywig if my goods were already put into my warehouse without my knowledge?

Here, take my ledger down to Dizzywig and have him double check my inventory records against his logs.
890-accept.title: The Missing Shipment

895-accept.name: Unknown
895-accept.text:
WANTED!

Baron Longshore, Captain of the Heedless

Captain Longshore of Gilneas leads vessels of the Southsea Freebooters, and is wanted on charges of piracy. Remains must be in identifiable condition!

-- Gazlowe
895-accept.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

895-complete.name: Gazlowe
895-complete.text:
Ahhhh! That sort of business. You know, I saw the Heedless once on the open seas. Fearsome ship, or was that boat... those sailors are so particular!

Anyways, watching her glide across the water was quite a sight to see. I'm glad her infamous captain will trouble my ships no longer.
895-complete.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

895-progress.name: Gazlowe
895-progress.text: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
895-progress.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

896-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-progress.text: If only we knew which one of the miners had found the emerald, it'd be a walk in the park...
896-progress.title: Miner's Fortune

92706-accept.name: Unknown
92706-accept.text:
Calling all anglers!

A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!

-- Gazlowe
92706-accept.title: WANTED: Bruuz

97977-accept.name: Tarindrella
97977-accept.text:
The Gnarlpine furbolg would not turn on their ancient allies so readily. We must learn more of their plight.

Search their abandoned homes for totems. If any survived the chaos of their departure, their engravings may tell us more of what happened here.

You'll find their camps along the western edge of the glen, though the grell and grellkin may have scattered them beyond.
97977-accept.title: Nature's Call
